Four prose files. Four places to keep in sync. Update one, forget another. Context rot What if there was one source of truth? project.faf is ~35 lines of structured YAML. entry.title: The Science of Regret: Why We Fear Wrong Choices
entry.summary:
The Science of Regret: Why We Fear Wrong Choices
In 1995, psychologists Thomas Gilovich and Victoria Medvec asked elderly people a simple question: What do you regret most? The answers followed a striking pattern. In the short term, people regretted things they did -- bad investments, failed relationships, embarrassing incidents. But over the long term, regrets about inaction dominated overwhelmingly. The things they didn't try. The chances they didn't take. The words they didn't say. This finding has been replicated dozens of times across cultures and demographics. It reveals something fundamental about regret: our fear of wrong choices is systematically miscalibrated. We fear action when we should fear inaction. entry.title: Step-by-Step Guide: How to Install a Theme on WordPress (For Beginners)
entry.summary:
Installing a theme is one of the first steps in building a WordPress website. A good theme sets the tone for your site’s design, layout, and user experience. Whether you’re making a blog, business site, or portfolio, knowing how to install and manage themes is essential. In WordPress, themes can be installed directly from the dashboard or uploaded manually. First, explore the Appearance → Themes section to browse free themes. You can preview how they look before activating. For premium or custom themes, upload the ZIP file and activate it. After installation, customize colors, fonts, headers, and menus to match your brand using the WordPress customizer or page builders like Elementor. Understanding this process helps you learn how WordPress handles design templates, theme settings, and layout controls — valuable skills for anyone working with WordPress sites. Learning how to install themes also makes it easier to explore and test different designs without fear of breaking your site. For a clear, beginner-friendly guide on installing themes in WordPress, check this resource: https://themexriver.com/install-a-theme-on-wordpress/
